  /* Card Grid */

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

flag_files <- list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$") |> sort()

feminine_codes <- c(
  "aq", "ar", "as", "at", "aw", "ax", "az", "bg", "bh", "bi", "bl", "bn", "bq",
  "bs", "bt", "bw", "ca", "cd", "cf", "ci", "cl", "cr", "cu", "cy", "cz", "dj",
  "dm", "dz", "ec", "ee", "er", "es", "fi", "fj", "fm", "fo", "fr", "ga", "gb",
  "gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls", "ge", "gg", "gi", "gl", "gn", "gr",
  "gt", "gw", "gy", "hk", "hn", "hr", "hu", "id", "ie", "il", "in", "io", "is",
  "it", "je", "jp", "km", "kr", "lb", "lc", "lr", "ls", "lu", "mc", "mf", "mg",
  "ml", "mm", "mo", "mp", "mt", "mu", "my", "nc", "ne", "ng", "ni", "nl", "np",
  "nu", "pa", "pe", "pf", "pl", "pm", "pr", "pw", "py", "qa", "re", "ru", "rw",
  "se", "sg", "si", "sk", "sl", "sm", "so", "sr", "sv", "sz", "tf", "th", "tj",
  "tv", "tz", "ua", "um", "us", "uy", "uz", "va", "vi", "xk", "yt"
)

monarchies_const <- c(
  "ad", "ag", "au", "be", "bs", "bt", "bz", "ca", "dk", "es", "gb", "gd", "jm",
  "jp", "kh", "kn", "kw", "lc", "li", "ls", "lu", "ma", "mc", "my", "nl", "no",
  "nz", "pg", "sb", "se", "th", "to", "tv", "vc", "ws"
)
monarchies_abs <- c("bn", "om", "qa", "sa", "sz", "va", "ae")
federal_pres <- c("ar", "br", "km", "fm", "mx", "ng", "ss", "us", "ve")
federal_parl <- c("at", "au", "ba", "be", "ca", "ch", "de", "et", "in", "iq", "my", "np", "pk", "ru", "so", "st", "ae")
one_party_or_transitional <- c("af", "cn", "cu", "er", "kp", "la", "mm", "sd", "sy", "td", "vn", "ye", "bf", "ml", "ne", "gn", "ga")
parl_republics <- c(
  "al", "am", "bb", "bd", "bg", "cz", "dm", "ee", "fi", "fj", "ge", "gr",
  "hr", "hu", "ie", "il", "is", "it", "lb", "lt", "lv", "md", "me", "mk", "mt",
  "mu", "pl", "pt", "ro", "rs", "sg", "si", "sk", "sm", "tl", "tr", "tt", "vu", "xk", "za"
)
territories <- c(
  "ai", "aq", "as", "aw", "ax", "bl", "bm", "bq", "bv", "cc", "ck", "cw", "cx",
  "eh", "fk", "fo", "gf", "gg", "gi", "gl", "gp", "gs", "gu", "hk", "hm", "im",
  "io", "je", "ky", "mf", "mo", "mp", "mq", "ms", "nc", "nf", "nu", "pf", "pm",
  "pn", "pr", "ps", "re", "sh", "sj", "sx", "tc", "tf", "tk", "tw", "um", "vg",
  "vi", "wf", "yt"
)

featured_notes <- c(
  "hk" = "Centers a blooming five-petal white Bauhinia orchid flower with stars inside each petal—one of the world's most iconic floral flags.",
  "mp" = "Encircles a Chamorro latte stone with a colorful island flower crown (mwarmwar) of hibiscus, plumeria, and ylang-ylang on pastel Pacific blue.",
  "es" = "Features the rare heraldic purpure (pinkish-purple) Crowned Lion of León on its royal coat of arms.",
  "dm" = "Showcases the endangered purple-chested Sisserou parrot encircled by ten lime-green stars.",
  "mo" = "Displays a serene three-petal white lotus flower floating above water and a five-star golden arc.",
  "ar" = "Famous for its pastel sky-blue (celeste) and white horizontal bands crowned with the radiant golden Sun of May.",
  "bs" = "Blends soft Caribbean aquamarine blue with warm golden sand.",
  "pw" = "Pairs a luminous pastel ocean-blue field with a warm golden full moon.",
  "mz" = "The boldest martial emblem on Earth: an AK-47 assault rifle with a fixed bayonet crossed with an iron hoe.",
  "ao" = "Divided into stark crimson and jet black, emblazoned with a crossed machete and industrial gear wheel.",
  "al" = "Commands attention with Skanderbeg's fierce black double-headed eagle on a deep blood-red field.",
  "lk" = "Features a golden heraldic lion gripping a castane war sword on a deep crimson panel.",
  "sa" = "Displays an unsheathed white saber beneath the Arabic Shahada on rich emerald green.",
  "ke" = "Centers a Maasai warrior shield and two crossed white spears over bold black, crimson, and forest stripes.",
  "pg" = "Splits diagonally into jet black and crimson with the Southern Cross and a soaring bird-of-paradise.",
  "ug" = "Stacks six high-contrast black, gold, and crimson bands around a bold crested crane."
)

flags_df <- tibble(file = flag_files) |>
  mutate(
    code = str_remove(file, "\\.png$"),
    iso2_upper = toupper(code)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    countrycode::codelist |>
      select(
        iso2c,
        country_name = cldr.short.en,
        continent,
        subregion = region23,
        currency
      ),
    by = c("iso2_upper" = "iso2c")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    country_name = case_match(
      code,
      "gb-eng" ~ "England",
      "gb-nir" ~ "Northern Ireland",
      "gb-sct" ~ "Scotland",
      "gb-wls" ~ "Wales",
      "xk" ~ "Kosovo",
      .default = coalesce(country_name, iso2_upper)
    ),
    continent = case_when(
      code %in% c("gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls", "xk") ~ "Europe",
      code == "aq" ~ "Antarctica",
      code %in% c("bv", "gs", "hm", "tf") ~ "Antarctica & Southern Ocean",
      code == "tw" ~ "Asia",
      TRUE ~ coalesce(continent, "Global / Insular")
    ),
    subregion = case_when(
      code %in% c("gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls") ~ "Northern Europe",
      code == "xk" ~ "Southern Europe",
      code == "tw" ~ "Eastern Asia",
      code %in% c("aq", "bv", "gs", "hm", "tf") ~ "Sub-Antarctic",
      TRUE ~ coalesce(subregion, continent)
    ),
    category = if_else(code %in% feminine_codes, "Feminine", "Masculine"),
    is_featured = code %in% names(featured_notes),
    government = case_when(
      code %in% c("gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls") ~ "Devolved UK Nation",
      code %in% c("hk", "mo") ~ "Special Admin. Region",
      code == "va" ~ "Elective Theocracy",
      code == "aq" ~ "Treaty Condominium",
      code == "tw" ~ "Semi-Presidential Republic",
      code == "ch" ~ "Federal Directorial Republic",
      code == "ir" ~ "Theocratic Republic",
      code %in% territories ~ "Autonomous Territory",
      code %in% monarchies_abs ~ "Absolute Monarchy",
      code %in% monarchies_const ~ "Constitutional Monarchy",
      code %in% federal_pres ~ "Federal Pres. Republic",
      code %in% federal_parl ~ "Federal Parl. Republic",
      code %in% one_party_or_transitional ~ "Single-Party / Transitional",
      code %in% parl_republics ~ "Parliamentary Republic",
      TRUE ~ "Presidential Republic"
    ),
    aesthetic_style = if_else(
      category == "Feminine",
      "Floral, Pastel & Luminous Harmony",
      "Martial, Heraldic & High-Contrast Power"
    ),
    description = case_when(
      code %in% names(featured_notes) ~ unname(featured_notes[code]),
      category == "Feminine" ~ paste0(
        "A ", tolower(government), " in ", subregion, " whose flag uses luminous white, sky-blue, or soft balanced tones that give it an airy, welcoming visual presence."
      ),
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        "A ", tolower(government), " in ", subregion, " whose flag commands attention with deep crimson, obsidian black, or bold heraldic geometry."
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(country_name)

ojs_define(flags_data = flags_df)
```

    Explore all <strong>254 world and territory flags</strong> organized by visual design psychology—from delicate <strong>orchid blossoms, island flower wreaths, and pastel skies</strong> to <strong>crossed swords, fierce eagles, and obsidian-crimson heraldry</strong>—paired with each nation's system of government.

    <span class="hero-stat-pill stat-fem">🌸 125 Feminine Flags &bull; Floral, Pastel &amp; Luminous</span>

```{ojs}
flags = transpose(flags_data)

viewof spotlight_cat = Inputs.radio(
  ["✨ All 254 Flags", "🌸 Feminine Collection (125)", "⚔️ Masculine Collection (129)"],
  { label: "Spotlight Filter:", value: "✨ All 254 Flags" }
)

filtered_spotlight_list = flags.filter(d => {
  if (spotlight_cat.startsWith("🌸")) return d.category === "Feminine";
  if (spotlight_cat.startsWith("⚔️")) return d.category === "Masculine";
  return true;
})

viewof selected_country = Inputs.select(filtered_spotlight_list, {
  label: "Inspect Flag:",
  format: d => `${d.country_name} (${d.code.toUpperCase()}) — ${d.category === "Feminine" ? "🌸 Feminine" : "⚔️ Masculine"}`,
  value: filtered_spotlight_list.find(d => d.code === "hk") || filtered_spotlight_list[0]
})

html`<div class="spotlight-stage ${selected_country.category === 'Feminine' ? 'spotlight-fem' : 'spotlight-masc'}">
  <div class="spotlight-flag-box">
    <img src="w2560/${selected_country.file}" alt="${selected_country.country_name} flag">
  </div>
  <div>
    <div style="margin-bottom: 0.65rem;">
      <span class="pill ${selected_country.category === 'Feminine' ? 'pill-fem-cat' : 'pill-masc-cat'}">
        ${selected_country.category === 'Feminine' ? '🌸 Feminine Aesthetic' : '⚔️ Masculine Aesthetic'}
      </span>
      <span class="pill ${selected_country.category === 'Feminine' ? 'pill-fem-gov' : 'pill-masc-gov'}">
        🏛️ ${selected_country.government}
      </span>
      <span class="pill ${selected_country.category === 'Feminine' ? 'pill-fem-reg' : 'pill-masc-reg'}">
        🌍 ${selected_country.subregion} &bull; ${selected_country.continent}
      </span>
    </div>
    <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 2rem; margin: 0.2rem 0 0.6rem 0; color: inherit;">
      ${selected_country.country_name}
      <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; opacity: 0.7; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600;">
        [${selected_country.code.toUpperCase()}]
      </span>
    </h2>
    <p style="font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 1rem; opacity: 0.92;">
      ${selected_country.description}
    </p>
    <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.8; border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3); padding-top: 0.75rem;">
      <strong>Design Signature:</strong> ${selected_country.aesthetic_style} &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp;
      <strong>Currency:</strong> ${selected_country.currency || "Local / Shared"}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 🌸 Feminine Collection (125)

```{ojs}
viewof search_fem = Inputs.text({
  label: "🔍 Search Feminine:",
  placeholder: "Search by country, flower, monarchy, republic, or region..."
})

fem_flags = flags
  .filter(d => d.category === "Feminine")
  .sort((a, b) => (b.is_featured - a.is_featured) || a.country_name.localeCompare(b.country_name))
  .filter(d => {
    const q = search_fem.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return true;
    return (
      d.country_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.government.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.subregion.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.code.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  })

html`<div class="flag-grid">
  ${fem_flags.map(d => html`<div class="flag-card fem-card">
    <div class="flag-card-img">
      <img src="w2560/${d.file}" loading="lazy" alt="${d.country_name}">
    </div>
    <div class="flag-card-body">
      <div class="flag-card-title">
        <span>${d.is_featured ? "🌸 " : ""}${d.country_name}</span>
        <span class="flag-card-code">${d.code.toUpperCase()}</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <span class="pill pill-fem-gov">🏛️ ${d.government}</span>
        <span class="pill pill-fem-reg">🌍 ${d.subregion}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flag-card-desc">${d.description}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`)}
</div>`
```

### 🌍 Side-by-Side World Explorer (All 254)

```{ojs}
continents = ["All Continents", ...new Set(flags.map(d => d.continent)).values()].sort()
gov_types = ["All Government Styles", ...new Set(flags.map(d => d.government)).values()].sort()

viewof filter_continent = Inputs.select(continents, { label: "Continent:", value: "All Continents" })
viewof filter_gov = Inputs.select(gov_types, { label: "Government:", value: "All Government Styles" })
viewof filter_aes = Inputs.radio(["Both (254)", "🌸 Feminine", "⚔️ Masculine"], { label: "Aesthetic:", value: "Both (254)" })

all_filtered = flags.filter(d => {
  if (filter_continent !== "All Continents" && d.continent !== filter_continent) return false;
  if (filter_gov !== "All Government Styles" && d.government !== filter_gov) return false;
  if (filter_aes.includes("Feminine") && d.category !== "Feminine") return false;
  if (filter_aes.includes("Masculine") && d.category !== "Masculine") return false;
  return true;
})

html`<div class="flag-grid">
  ${all_filtered.map(d => html`<div class="flag-card ${d.category === 'Feminine' ? 'fem-card' : 'masc-card'}">
    <div class="flag-card-img">
      <img src="w2560/${d.file}" loading="lazy" alt="${d.country_name}">
    </div>
    <div class="flag-card-body">
      <div class="flag-card-title">
        <span>${d.category === 'Feminine' ? '🌸 ' : '⚔️ '}${d.country_name}</span>
        <span class="flag-card-code">${d.code.toUpperCase()}</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <span class="pill ${d.category === 'Feminine' ? 'pill-fem-gov' : 'pill-masc-gov'}">🏛️ ${d.government}</span>
        <span class="pill ${d.category === 'Feminine' ? 'pill-fem-reg' : 'pill-masc-reg'}">🌍 ${d.subregion}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flag-card-desc">${d.description}</div>
    </div>
  </div>`)}
</div>`
```

:::
